_comment: Pinned settings for load-tests/loadgen.py. Prices, the shared cap and the token assumptions are pinned here; a command-line flag can only LOWER what is spent, never raise the cap. Rates: claude-haiku-5-5 on the Anthropic API (primary since repair round 3, user decision 2026-11-09 after the instructor ruling), USD 0.10 input / 0.50 output per 1M tokens for prompts under 100,000 tokens (the price is higher above that size; our prompts stay far below it), confirmed from the Anthropic pricing page on 2026-11-09 (docs/agent-runs/phase-14/prompt.md, 'Subphase 14B repair round 3', Step 0 answer 2). The selectable fallback is the Bedrock route us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 at USD 1.10 / 5.50 (geo cross-region, US East (Ohio)); it is NOT priced by this file unless the pricing block is switched back. Token counts are the Phase 14 replan estimate (planner 1,500 in + 200 out, synthesis 4,000 in + 800 out) raised 30 percent because the claude-haiku-5-5 tokenizer produces about 30 percent more tokens than Haiku 4.5: planner 1,950 in + 260 out, synthesis 5,200 in + 1,040 out. The shared cap stays USD 1.33 (user decision 2026-11-09, easiest option): at these rates 115 answers cost about USD 0.157, so the cap is a conservative upper bound and the bucket counts are the binding limit. The cost per answer is derived, ESTIMATED and not metered: the final cost comes from the provider consoles (Anthropic, Voyage) and the AWS bill, reported as separate items and then combined.

llm.shared_cap_scope: Phase 14C smoke + 15B + 16B + 17 (one cap for the whole session; split into answer buckets in experiments/manifests/llm-allocation.json; 115 answers cost about USD 0.157 at the pinned estimate, so the bucket counts bind first)

pricing.fallback_model_route: us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 (Amazon Bedrock geo cross-region; selectable with SCHOLARCHAIN_SYNTHESIS_PROVIDER=bedrock, priced at 1.10 / 5.50 per 1M tokens)
pricing.price_tier: prompts under 100,000 tokens (0.50 / 2.50 per 1M above that size; not used)

llm.tokens_per_answer_basis: Haiku 4.5 plan 1,500 / 200 / 4,000 / 800 raised 30 percent (tokenizer), rounded up to whole tokens

embeddings.free_tokens_scope: per Voyage account; the first 200M tokens are free (Voyage docs, fetched 2026-11-09)
embeddings.token_counter: required: every embedding step (14C ingest and query smoke, 16B evaluation) adds the tokens it sent to a counter and stops when the cap would be passed; a provider with no charge is reported as USD 0 with its token usage
embeddings.fallback: Amazon Titan Text Embeddings V2 on Bedrock (SCHOLARCHAIN_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=bedrock); switching the embedding model needs a full re-embed and an index rebuild

cost_reporting.combined: sum of the items; a provider with no charge is USD 0 with its usage noted
cost_reporting.aws_source: AWS bill and the pre-spend receipts; not metered by the load generator
